deployments_detail.use: Visa Advanced Authorization (VAA): AI/deep-learning engine embedded in VisaNet that scores every transaction for fraud risk in real time (0-99) at the point of authorization, across Visa and non-Visa payments. [Visa in-house deep learning models]
deployments_detail.value: Helped combat ~$40 billion in fraud in a year; analyzes 500+ risk attributes per transaction

deployments_detail.use: Visa Intelligent Commerce with OpenAI: platform embedding Visa payment credentials, controls and protections so AI agents (including within ChatGPT) can initiate and complete purchases securely on users' behalf. [OpenAI (ChatGPT agents)]
Secure AI-powered agent-initiated transactions and agentic commerce payments [Trusted Agent Protocol]
Visa Intelligent Commerce - AI agents for personalized and secure shopping experiences

Six new AI-powered dispute-resolution tools that use generative AI to manage credit-card charge disputes, including generative-AI responses and 'win-prediction scoring' to maximize recovery for merchants and issuers. [Visa generative AI]

Internal generative-AI productivity stack: Visa's ~32,000 employees have access to an internal version of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and GitHub Copilot for everyday work and software development. [OpenAI (ChatGPT), Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot]
Autonomous AI agents built in Microsoft Copilot Studio to automate internal employee workflows such as wellness-reimbursement processing, eliminating manual steps. [Microsoft Copilot Studio]
"Visa Intelligent Commerce" agentic-AI payments + AI fraud detection (Decision Manager screens billions of transactions)

Visa Account Attack Intelligence (VAAI) Score: generative-AI solution that scores card-not-present transactions for likelihood of enumeration/account-attack, enabling issuers to block fraudulent activity in real time. [Visa generative AI]

Visa Provisioning Intelligence (VPI): ML-based product that rates the likelihood of fraud for token provisioning requests, helping issuers distinguish genuine from fraudulent token requests and reduce false positives. [Visa machine learning]
deployments_detail.value: Targets ~$450 million in global token fraud losses (2022)

deployments_detail.use: Visa A2A Protect: real-time AI risk-scoring solution for account-to-account (real-time) payments that detects scams and fraud and assigns risk scores to help banks intercept suspicious transactions. [Visa AI]

Visa Scam Disruption (VSD): a dedicated practice using generative-AI modeling on network-level data to detect complex scam behaviors, uncover hidden criminal relationships, and dismantle scam networks proactively. [Visa generative AI]
deployments_detail.value: Prevented more than $350 million in attempted fraud in 2024; later disclosed uncovering $2.6bn in fraudulent activity

deployments_detail.use: Trusted Agent Protocol: an ecosystem framework for agentic commerce that authenticates AI shopping agents and enables secure communication between AI agents and merchants to prevent fraud (adopted with partners such as Akamai). [Visa (ecosystem: Akamai, Cloudflare and others)]
AI-based fraud detection and risk management
Generative AI applications including customer onboarding and fraud detection

Visa 'ai' developer toolkit (github.com/visa/ai): reusable packages, client examples, an AI agent demo, Claude Code skills and a Gemini CLI extension for connecting AI agents to Visa Intelligent Commerce. [Anthropic (Claude Code skills), Google (Gemini CLI)]
